queries.query: Deir el-Balah State of Palestine official cadastral parcel map cadastre GIS land registry Gaza
queries.result: First-party discovery located the Palestinian Land Authority's Gaza land-registration pages, a public Gaza parcel-location service, its linked public ArcGIS viewer, and a 2022 Gaza Web Map containing polygon parcel layers. The viewer metadata identifies the Gaza land-authority GIS department and a public map extent covering Deir el-Balah.

queries.query: دير البلح فلسطين خريطة عقارية كادستر أراضي سجل الأراضي نظام معلومات جغرافي
queries.result: البحث العربي في المصادر الرسمية لسلطة الأراضي الفلسطينية أظهر الإدارة العامة لتسجيل الأراضي، منظومة عقارية جغرافية، خدمة التحقق من موقع القسائم، وإعلان مشروع التسوية الشاملة الذي يذكر دير البلح ضمن بلديات المحافظة الوسطى. بيانات عارض ArcGIS العام تضمنت طبقات قسائم مضلعة لمنطقة غزة وتحققاً مكانياً محدوداً حول النقطة المحفوظة.

registryCustodian: Palestinian Land Authority (سلطة الأراضي الفلسطينية), Gaza land-registration and surveying/GIS departments.

registryEvidence.evidence: The official Land Authority identifies land-registration functions and states that the 2022 comprehensive settlement phase included Deir el-Balah among the central Gaza municipalities. Its public citizen-services page links to a public ArcGIS location viewer. The viewer's public app configuration names the Palestinian Land Authority - Gaza and its geospatial information systems department; the public Web Map extent covers the preserved point and contains polygon layers with Deir el-Balah-area features.

Only OBJECTID was selected as the canonical native identity for the bounded evidence; no source attribute set was retained.
sourceReview.compositeKeyProvenance: The source visibly includes Arabic block/parcel components رقم_ا, رقم__1 and a combined display value القسي. No composite identity was constructed; canonical identity is the source OBJECTID.
sourceReview.dataVintage: The public app configuration says the displayed data was last updated May 2022; the Web Map item was modified 2022-06-14. Current completeness is not established.

No raw source-specific attribute set was retained. No GeoJSON sample was retained because the evidence was an embedded Web Map snapshot and the requested packet does not require a sample.
